errors.text: The intervention is unspecified thermomechanical processing rather than a defined thermal-aging treatment in the relevant 550–750°C window.
The hypothesis misses the observed non-monotonic ductile–brittle–ductile response, including maximum embrittlement near 600°C and recovery near 750°C.

The proposed grain-refinement and intermetallic-suppression mechanism is not supported by the supplied observations and omits L12 ordering, increased APBE, planar slip, jagged FCC/B2 phase boundaries, and phase-boundary crack initiation.
Loading below yield strength cannot adequately assess toughness or expose the plastic-instability and fracture mechanisms at issue.
No experiment verifies retention of the original strength–ductility combination, which is an explicit constraint.
